notes.title: Update V0.3.2
notes.content:
Hello again! I made level 2 way to difficult so here is some changes that I made to make it easier:

 Monster gets aggressive less fast in level 2
 Clock event is easier to complete
 Memory game is random and bigger to match more with the length of the other puzzles
 Added a new "Hard Mode", unlocked after completing level 2, for the players that want the extra challenge

 Hard mode is (for now) exclusive for level 2
 It has a more difficult clock event
 Monster gets aggressive faster
 Special achievement for completing hard mode

Apart from the difficulty changes, here are some other things I changed

 Fixed a bug where the cursor would not stay inside the window on multi monitor setups
 Fixed a bug where the simon says puzzle could get pressed when moving


Thanks for all the help playtesting so far! Let me know if you find any more bugs

notes.title: Patch V0.3.1
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the playtest! There was a slight bug and this update changes the following: 

 Fixed level statistics not reseting after level restart

notes.title: V0.3 Out now
notes.content:
115 days after the release of v0.2, I'm happy to announce that v0.3 is officially out! Here's a list of the major changes!

Added level 2 which includes

 A new One Socket experience in a smaller claustrophobic room
 4 new puzzles: Memory, Graph, Slide, and Clock
 2 event puzzles: Pipe, and Clock 
 A new monster that is angered by the sounds you make 
Level 1 changes 
 Improved monster model and jumpscare
 New Dial puzzle
 Slightly decreased difficulty 
 Other general changes 
 New transition between lvl 1 and 2
 Improved menus
 Improved progression system
